nodes.name: Webhook (upload invoice)
nodes.notes: multipart/form-data, field 'file' (PDF/PNG/JPG, max 5 MB). Enable Header Auth before exposing publicly. Do not upload real invoices to a demo.

nodes.name: Mock Invoices (8 cases)
nodes.notes: Test harness: 8 synthetic text invoices with expected results.

nodes.name: Normalize
nodes.notes: SHA-256 file hash, type sniffing (magic bytes), 5 MB limit.

nodes.name: Read Existing Rows
nodes.notes: One read per run; feeds both dedupe tiers.

nodes.name: Build AI Request
nodes.notes: Text is sent as untrusted data; files are sent as inline base64.

nodes.name: Gemini Extract
nodes.notes: Header Auth credential: name x-goog-api-key, value = your Gemini key. 3 tries, then error output -> needs_review.

nodes.name: Validate
nodes.notes: All decisions are made here, in code. AI only extracts.

nodes.name: Dedupe Invoice
nodes.notes: Tier 2: same vendor + invoice number, different file.

nodes.name: Due Status
nodes.notes: overdue / due_soon / ok / unknown (processed only). Computed before saving so the sheet row is complete.

nodes.name: Save to Sheet
nodes.notes: appendOrUpdate on file_hash. Saved BEFORE any alert.

nodes.name: Notify Staff (Telegram)
nodes.notes: Internal staff only. Continue on fail: a failed alert never loses the saved record.

nodes.name: Test Report
nodes.notes: Only outputs for the manual mock run: case | expected | actual | PASS/FAIL.

parameters.content:
## AI Invoice Extraction & Validation (Demo)
**Receive -> Extract -> Validate -> Dedupe -> Store -> Alert**

AI only extracts. Every decision (needs_review, duplicates, due status) is made by code. Nothing is approved, paid or sent to vendors.

Synthetic data only. Do not upload real invoices.

### Test harness
Run Test Cases -> 8 mock invoices -> same pipeline from Normalize -> Test Report (PASS/FAIL).
